leftEvidence.title: The man is formed, placed, and commanded

points.label: Time language
points.left: The LORD God forms the man from ground dust, breathes life into him, places him in Eden to serve and keep it, and gives one tree command with a death warning.
points.right: The genealogy recalls image, male and female, blessing, and the name Adam, then records Seth in Adam’s likeness, other children, nine hundred thirty years, and death.

points.label: Source setting
points.left: Created, formed, and placed · core · Genesis 2:4–17
points.right: Children, generations, and death · core · Genesis 5:1–5

payload.posture: The man is told that in the day he eats he will surely die is held beside Adam lives nine hundred thirty years, then dies.

rightEvidence.title: Adam’s generations end with his death

payload.tension: The warning names death in the day of eating, while the genealogy records many years before Adam dies.
payload.title: The death warning and Adam’s recorded death
